voci: Line-ups and predictions work even when the xG (expected goals) statistics are not there yet: they no longer give an error.
With English selected, the verdict on trades (good for you, for them or for neither), the explanation of the numbers and the reasons why a trade cannot be made are also written in English.
With English selected, the "Under the hood" texts (explanations, formulas, glossary and names of the measures) are also written in English.
With English selected, the alerts about a position with too few players or no backup (for example "You have only 2 defenders available...") are also written in English.
In Settings > Appearance you can also choose Market, Trades and League as your start section, besides Today and Line-up.

1.209.titolo: More readable app on large screens
voci: On large screens (Full HD, 2K, ultrawide) the app scales up by itself: text and buttons stay readable with the browser at 100%, and the cards spread over more columns without big empty spaces.

1.208.titolo: English: "To do", reasons and probable line-ups
voci: With English selected, the "To do" sentences (doubts about starters, deadlines, data copies), the reasons behind the advice (for example "starter at 85%") and the time of the probable line-ups are also written in English.

1.207.titolo: Privacy and Terms also in English
voci: The Privacy, Terms of use, Credits and "Delete your account" pages can now also be read in English: with English selected, the links in the app open the English version. At the top it says it is a translation and links to the Italian text, which is the one that counts.

1.206.titolo: English: guided setup and first start
voci: With English selected, the guided first sign-in and the first-start steps (squads, team, crest, installation, widget, alerts) are also in English.

1.205.titolo: English: alerts, backup, diary, search and icon
voci: With English selected, alerts, the safety copy, the matchday diary, the model test, player search, the app icon and the line-up image to share are also in English.

1.204.titolo: English: Team, More, Rules and What's new
voci: With English selected, the Team and More entries, the Rules screen, What's new, Under the hood, crest and shirt and the season change are also in English.
The Privacy page explains that, if you ask, whoever runs the app can import your squads for you and keeps the last 5 copies of your previous squads, deleted together with your account.
If you import your squads twice almost at the same time, the second waits for the first: no more squads lost or mixed up.

1.201.titolo: English: Trades, squad and data status
voci: With English selected, Trades (find, build, evaluate an offer), the squad page and the data status are also in English.
"Show all features" only shows the menus: features turned off by whoever runs the app, such as images from a web address and live results, stay off for everyone.
With English selected, the Market (recommended, players, watchlist, calendar), the player page and the comparison are also in English.

1.198.titolo: More readable pitch in the light theme
voci: In the light theme the green pitch is a little darker, so the names and numbers in white are easier to read.

1.197.titolo: Sign-in in the middle of the screen
voci: On a computer the sign-in page (and sign-up, forgotten password and the guided first start) now sits in the middle of the screen, no longer low down.
